slot.brief: Simple statement-selection: image formation plane mirror / total internal reflection conditions / power of lens in medium; pick correct statement among simple ray-optics assertions.

stem: A transparent medium has relative permittivity $4$ and relative permeability $1$. It is surrounded by air. Which of the following statements is correct?
options: The critical angle for light travelling from the medium to air is $30^\circ$.
Total internal reflection occurs when light travels from air into the medium at an angle greater than the critical angle.
A plane mirror forms a real image of a real object.
The power of a glass convex lens increases when it is immersed in water.

verdicts.working: The medium’s refractive index is \(n=\sqrt{\varepsilon_r\mu_r}=2\). Thus \(\sin C=1/2\), so \(C=30^\circ\). Total internal reflection requires travel from higher to lower refractive index; a plane mirror gives a virtual image of a real object, and immersing a glass lens in water reduces its power.

working:
$n=\sqrt{\varepsilon_r\mu_r}=2$; $\sin C=\dfrac{1}{n}=\dfrac12\Rightarrow C=30^\circ$.

solution: The refractive index of the medium is $n=\sqrt{\varepsilon_r\mu_r}=2$. For light travelling from the medium to air, $\sin C=\dfrac{1}{n}=\dfrac12$, hence $C=30^\circ$.

draft.stem: A transparent medium has relative permittivity $4$ and relative permeability $1$. It is surrounded by air. Which of the following statements is correct?
options: The critical angle for light travelling from the medium to air is $30^\circ$.
Total internal reflection occurs when light travels from air into the medium at an angle greater than the critical angle.

draft.distractor_notes: B: reverses the required direction of travel for total internal reflection. C: confuses the virtual image formed by a plane mirror with a real image. D: overlooks that immersion in water reduces the refractive-index contrast and hence the lens power.
